verdict.rationale: Docs confirm built-in error handling: automatic retries on transient errors, default email notification on unhandled errors, and surfaced error details/stack traces with AI debugging assistance. However, there's no evidence of dedicated, configurable error-workflow paths (e.g., routing failed events to a separate branch/workflow) or customizable alerting channels beyond the default email. missing for 10: explicit support for defining separate error-handling workflows/branches, configurable notification channels (Slack, PagerDuty, webhook) beyond default email, independent/hands-on corroboration of these error features in production use.
